verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Generative AI features" as a plan feature, which suggests some built-in AI content generation. Nothing describes what those features do or where they appear. The only other AI-creation claim is about building campaigns from an external chat AI, not the built-in composer. Missing for 10: documentation that the built-in AI drafts or refines subject lines and body copy, evidence it works inside the email composer, brief-to-copy generation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
